newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK interbank rates unchanged, awaiting U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: HK interbank rates unchanged, awaiting U.S. data.

text.p: Hong Kong interbank market rates were mostly unchanged on Thursday as market participants chose to remain sidelined awaiting further data from the United States, dealers said.
The overnight was unchanged at 5-1/8 percent while three month money finished at 5-1/2 7/16 percent, also unchanged.
"The market is very quiet, everyone is waiting to see what happens with the U.S. PPI (producer price index to be released on Friday)," a dealer with a foreign bank said.
Government paper yields were a touch higher.

Yields of seven-year Exchange Fund notes stood at 7.38 percent versus 7.36 percent on Wednesday, five years ended at 7.03 percent against 7.02 percent, and three-year notes finished at 6.41 percent versus 6.38 percent.
The one-week Exchange Fund bill closed the morning at 4.80 percent versus 4.78 percent.
